'''Ar'al Anec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Anec was a part of a joint team sent by the Empire and [[House of Thul|House Thul]] to establish a base in old [[Jedi ruins]] in the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] there by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual who was sent to stop Sith activities in the ruins.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Anec appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss character during the quest to kill Sith commanders in the ruins. It is not necessary to kill Anec to complete the quest. However, this article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
